parts.note_add: S-001 p.26/p.16: a two-wire chime (connector X-06) fed LY constant off the 15 A fuse; its G side is switched to ground by the Control Processing Unit (key reminder, lights-off) and by the C-10 oscillator (coolant/oil level warnings). The 1985 manual (S-002 p.15-12) calls it the buzzer in the meter.

S-001 p.26: H-09 connector LY (element feed, constant, 15 A fuse), RL (illumination bulb, from the panel light control) and B (ground to X-13 via X-02). No 1981-83 lighter listing found; 84-85 and 86-92 (FB01-66-250) lighters are sold, fit unconfirmed.
Carries the PT633 bulb; the ring itself has no terminal. Bulb wattage is SP-196.
3.4 W (SP-196, S-001 p.20) on RL from E-05 panel light control, ground B; so it dims with the dash. Trade number not found in any source; confirm the bulb type in the car.

S-001 p.28 draws each mirror as ONE motor plus ONE solenoid (LgY-B), not two motors as windows-mirrors.md says; the 1985 manual (S-002 p.15-42) draws the same. The switch energises the solenoid for up/down and reverses the motor. 1982 feed is WG constant (10 A), 1985 is L from ACC.
S-001 p.26: H-15 is a 4-cavity connector with two used, LR (20 A constant) and GB to the H-16 solenoid, which grounds at X-15; a momentary contact joins LR to GB.
S-001 p.24: G-13 'power antenna switch (without radio)', two wires LG and B; it grounds the LG coil side of the G-01 power antenna relay. Cars with the factory radio drive LG from the radio instead.
S-001 p.18: D-06 has B, BG and LW: one contact grounds BG (rear wiper motor D-05), the other grounds LW (rear washer motor D-04); both motors are fed L on their own 10 A ignition fuse.

Atkins Rotary lists FA01-66-120 new at 358.95 USD (2026-09) and the turn-signal switch alone as FA01-66-122. On S-001 it appears as E-01 (light/dimmer/passing, plus the GL horn lead), F-02 (turn/hazard) and D-03 (wiper/washer).
Atkins sells an 81-83 wiper switch as BA30-66-135 (95.00 USD), not the catalogue's BA30-66-123; whether it supersedes it is unconfirmed. S-001 p.18 connector D-03: B, LO, LY / LR, LG, LW.
Still sold new by Atkins Rotary (5.99 USD, fits all 81-85). The printable canceler bridge in the CAD library is the switch-side part the cam strikes.
S-001 p.22: the horn switch is a ground-side contact on GL through E-01 to the F-16 horn relay coil; it carries only relay coil current.
S-001 p.26: single-terminal switch on RY that grounds through its body; RY runs to the interior/spot light and the Control Processing Unit. New genuine B001-66-540 is still listed (about 7.50 USD).

Mazda's current catalogue names -66-450 parts 'Switch, parking lamp' and sells them as the park brake warning switch (GJ6G-66-450), which supports this being the S-001 C-04 parking brake switch (one BR wire, to ground). Still confirm on the car.
